decisions.reason: The naval vessel lighting system is a multi-model line with heavy certification and engineering investment and long naval procurement cycles, so management will attribute slow results to temporary causes and persist.
This second-generation interior luminaire extends an established core family, so the firm will keep it even though its website presence has shrunk from a dedicated page to a mention.

The microprismatic pendant is publicly presented as a flagship and was promoted as a latest release in 2024, so strong public commitment and fit with the firm's direction make dropping it very unlikely.

After the sister HMI searchlight was dropped, this marine searchlight likely remains as the consolidated, probably LED-based line, and management would justify the prior marine investment by keeping it, though some risk of further pruning remains.
